name: Valheim
tagline: BepInEx plugin that connects a Valheim dedicated server to Takaro.

assets.label: Plugin
assets.hint: Unzip so the TakaroValheim folder lands directly inside BepInEx/plugins/.

assets.label: Inventory companion (optional, players)
assets.hint: Optional: players who install it in BepInEx/plugins/ on their own game let Takaro read their inventory. Nothing else needs it.
